scope: Read-only source audit for analytics redesign; no SDK, gameplay, scene, configuration or tracking implementation changed. DJS spreadsheet is a comparison reference, not proof of current SDK behavior.
conclusions: Business events must use public instance SDKAdapter.Track. It forwards to Bizza and ThinkingData, not Adjust custom events.
New business user attributes must use BizzaAnalyticsAgent.BUserProp or UserProp. These are Bizza-only; they do not reach ThinkingData.
SDKAdapter.SetUserProperties is private and auto-sends SDK-owned identity/ad/attribution attributes to Bizza plus ThinkingData; do not expose it by reflection or alter read-only SDK.
Current Assets/SDK has no automatic register event. Bizza login is once per runtime initialization, not account login, install-first-only or foreground session.
Bizza login and user_profile_change do not forward to ThinkingData. ThinkingData auto lifecycle events do not forward to Bizza.
Bizza user_profile_change is a record type with key/old/new/ts, not a business event to emit through Track.
Avoid duplicating MaxTrack/ad_revenue, Adjust IPU milestone and native attribution/session reporting. Business reward grant and ad intent/outcome metrics must be distinguished from SDK ad lifecycle.
SDK auto lifecycle does not implement DJS session_start after 30-minute background or its 30-second gameplay/FPS session_summary.
SDKAdapter.Track has no delivery result and no generic deduplication. Bizza and TA can accept/drop independently; do not claim guaranteed exactly-once or identical counts.

facade.before_initialize: Track logs and drops; no facade queue (178–182).
facade.initialization: initializationStarted is set before SDK initialization completes (117). It is not a reliable all-backends-ready signal.
facade.recommendation: Configure one SDK scene node, reference it through serialized component from game analytics adapter. Use an explicit bounded game startup buffer if required; do not create UI/SDK hierarchy dynamically or invent Editor-only success fallback. Keep completion timestamps captured at event occurrence.

bizza.behavior: Agent BTrack/BUserProp EnsureRuntime; invalid encrypted config leaves runtime not-ready and incoming calls drop. Runtime accepts only IsReady && IsReportingEnabled && !shutdown. Reporting requires release plus sampling. Missing singleton silently skipped by facade. No pre-ready queue. Once ready, records enter persistent bounded queues; pause permits enqueue but suspends ordinary sender. Network retries operate on batches, not business dedup.
bizza.visibility: Agent exposes IsReady, IsReportingEnabled, LastError, DroppedRecordCount, LastDropReason and QueuedRecordCount.
bizza.platform_note: Awake auto-initialization is gated to Android non-Editor (Agent:199–205); explicit BTrack/BUserProp can call Initialize through EnsureRuntime. Existing SDK behavior must be reported accurately; this audit does not introduce or repair platform logic.
bizza.bounds: Default total queued records 10000, bytes 8 MiB, batch records 500, batch bytes 256 KiB, record bytes 32 KiB, retention 7 days. Limits/dropped diagnostics matter; no guaranteed shutdown flush.

thinkingdata.behavior: Queues up to 512 pending operations before Ready, rejects new on overflow; failed init remains buffering. Initialize drains pending operations, enables all auto-track, drains remaining, marks Ready. An executed operation exception logs and returns false; adapter does not requeue it. Facade ignores returned bool. SDK transport may independently cache/retry.
thinkingdata.snapshot: Only shallow dictionary copy (658–663). Avoid reusing/mutating nested payload objects after enqueue.

duplicate_suppression: No generic Bizza Track or SDKAdapter.Track event deduplication.
Bizza unchanged user value suppressed by DeepEquals; update_ip uses force=true so repeated same successful IP can still make a change record.
SDKFacade attribution signature suppresses identical six-field attribution per facade instance; Adjust adapter also suppresses identical attribution objects.
MAX active request and displayed/reward flags suppress duplicate current-show/earned-reward callback handling, not all paid-impression callbacks.
Bizza batch_id is a transport batch identity reused for retry; it does not prevent repeated caller Track calls or prove server exactly-once handling.

public_and_preset_properties.thinkingdata_identity: distinctId and accountId both appcode@cid; MAX UserId set to same. Adjust global callback params ta_distinct_id, ta_account_id, cid are set before initialization.

thinkingdata_super_properties.appcode: string. Facade clears prior super properties before setting this one at 289–293.

public_and_preset_properties.bizza_identity: Bizza uid and playerID separately generated/persisted (Runtime:373–383). They are not inherently the same as DeviceInfo cid or TA account ID. SDK-owned deviceId/appcode properties support correlation.
public_and_preset_properties.bizza_event_properties: Bizza does not merge stored user properties or SDKAdapter appcode into every business payload. If analysis needs event-time snapshots/session IDs, game event adapter must add explicit common fields before SDKAdapter.Track.
public_and_preset_properties.ta_native_presets_notes: These are SDK preset-accessor fields, not a promise every platform/event populates every field. Names differ from Bizza attrs; do not conflate availability/routes. Never send business fields using reserved # prefix.

bizza_property_semantics.merge: Top-level patch/set: supplied keys replace values; omitted existing keys retained. A supplied nested dictionary replaces the whole value; not recursive merge.
bizza_property_semantics.increment: No public Bizza Add/Increment/UserAdd. UserProp({count:1}) means set count=1, not +1. Compute absolute value from game authoritative persistent state, then set.
bizza_property_semantics.once: No public Bizza SetOnce. Business must guard first-seen properties using its authoritative persisted state if required.
bizza_property_semantics.null: Allowed as a value by Bizza; do not equate with delete semantics. No delete/remove API contract.
bizza_property_semantics.equality: Unchanged deep values skipped; primitive DeepEquals compares invariant string representations, so 1 and string '1' may be treated equal. Keep fixed property types across versions.
bizza_property_semantics.allowed: null, bool, string, finite numeric types; dictionaries/lists recursively normalized within budgets. DateTime/DateTimeOffset become UTC ISO strings; unknown objects become invariant strings. Business should explicitly use primitives/flat small payloads, never raw Unity objects or enum.ToString keys.
bizza_property_semantics.performance: User property change emits its own record; avoid per-frame setters and enormous mutable nested objects. Submit on real persistent state transitions or bounded milestones.

dual_backend_payload_contract.recommendation: Constrain business Track names/keys to ASCII letter first, snake_case alphanumeric/underscore, max 50 chars, fixed schema/types, finite numbers, no null values; omit unavailable optional fields. String UTF-8 max 2048 bytes. Use stable constants rather than enum.ToString. Both backends should receive same immutable flat dictionary.
dual_backend_payload_contract.reason: Bizza allows wider names/types than ThinkingData, so Bizza acceptance does not prove TA acceptance. TD checker regex is ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z\d_#]{0,49}$ with reserved internal whitelist; null property value flagged invalid; number range approximately +/-9999999999999.999. The Unity wrapper calls this checker but ignores its return for ordinary Track (Wrapper/TDWrapper.cs:214,231), so this audit uses it as the declared compatibility contract, not proof of an early rejection or native-server acceptance.

djs_lifecycle_recommendations.action: Retain only if consistent dual-backend install funnel required
djs_lifecycle_recommendations.reason: TA ta_app_install exists but Bizza has no register/first-open auto event. Persist local-install first-observed marker; never synthesize historical timestamp.
DJS starts on process launch or return after >=30 min background. Bizza login only initializes; TA app_start fires foreground without DJS rule. Use one stable session_id and explicit reason.
Game initialization success/failure/duration/phase is not covered by SDK lifecycle; capture before SDK ready and bounded-buffer if required without claiming lossless SDK init failure telemetry.

djs_lifecycle_recommendations.action: Narrow or remove generic duplicate transitions after defining analysis requirement
djs_lifecycle_recommendations.reason: TA already has foreground/background but Bizza does not. Keep only if dual-backend transition/ad-visible diagnostic needed; do not report both focus and pause callbacks as separate equivalent transitions.

djs_lifecycle_recommendations.action: Retain as observed normal exit or fold into session_summary with report_reason
djs_lifecycle_recommendations.reason: Mobile process kills often provide no quit callback. Cannot label all session endings or infer crash from missing event. DJS foreground/gameplay totals must actually be populated if retained.

djs_lifecycle_recommendations.action: Retain compact gameplay-quality metrics if required; reduce irrelevant context fields
djs_lifecycle_recommendations.reason: 30-second foreground/gameplay/ad duration + FPS windows are not Bizza cumulative game_duration nor TA app_end. Use window_start/end and summary_seq; avoid double-counting total vs window values; omit FPS if insufficient samples rather than null.

djs_lifecycle_recommendations.action: Replace stable device facts with Bizza user attributes; avoid duplicate event stream
djs_lifecycle_recommendations.reason: SDK already provides some Bizza/TA device attrs. Add only missing useful fields, with source/type. New Bizza attrs do not automatically reach TA.

djs_lifecycle_recommendations.action: Remove duplicated SDK facts as business event unless history-specific analysis explicitly needed
djs_lifecycle_recommendations.reason: SDK auto sends available attribution properties to both backends. Old publisher_* user/country/channel/active-days fields are not interchangeable with Adjust fields and unsupported placeholders must not be invented.
register absent; login and profile record Bizza-only SDK generated. Correct the comparison table rather than pretend uniform backend coverage.

djs_lifecycle_recommendations.action: Use existing MaxTrack + ad_revenue for SDK lifecycle; retain only distinct business intent/reward-application outcome as needed
djs_lifecycle_recommendations.reason: No second lifecycle/revenue stream. SDK ad_complete means rewarded callback, not game inventory credit; a separate actual reward-grant event after successful grant is legitimate with idempotent business reward ID.

validation_required_before_future_implem: Review this proposal first; no tracking code changed by this audit.
Validate startup ordering with scene-configured SDK/Bizza components; do not invoke network tracking during this audit.
On a controlled device/test environment verify both backend records for one business event and only Bizza user attribute record for one new business attribute.
Verify repeated business trigger guards, resumed session threshold, final partial summary, ad callbacks and actual reward granting exactly once at game level.
Keep SDK automatic names/typos unchanged and document them; no source edits to read-only SDK.
